title: Social Seller
description:
OPORTUNIDADE: SOCIAL SELLER (Remoto)


Transforme conexões em vendas reais no mercado digital

Você é apaixonado por redes sociais, sabe se conectar com pessoas de forma genuína e possui habilidade para transformar conversas em vendas?

Busca crescimento rápido, gosta de desafios e quer atuar ao lado de grandes experts do mercado digital?

Então essa vaga é para você.



Sobre a RedSuit

Na RedSuit, acreditamos que toda venda começa com um relacionamento verdadeiro.

Somos especialistas em potencializar resultados por meio de estratégias modernas de Social Selling — e agora buscamos alguém com energia, foco e vontade de crescer para integrar nosso time.


O que faz um Social Seller?

O Social Seller é responsável por conduzir vendas sociais por meio de interações estratégicas nas redes (Instagram, e outros canais).

Na prática, você atuará como um “clone digital” do expert, construindo relações, nutrindo leads e convertendo seguidores em clientes.


Responsabilidades Principais
  • Dar boas-vindas e engajar novos seguidores via Direct do Instagram
  • Construir e nutrir relacionamentos com leads qualificados
  • Fechar vendas diretamente ou agendar reuniões para Closers/Experts
  • Registrar e acompanhar todas as interações no CRM (Kommo)
  • Realizar follow-ups estratégicos para maximizar conversões
  • Gerar relatórios diários de performance e indicadores
  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento e estratégia



O que esperamos de você
  • Experiência prévia em vendas — preferencialmente no digital (infoprodutos, mentorias, lançamentos)
  • Excelente comunicação: clara, empática e persuasiva
  • Organização e disciplina para gerenciar múltiplos leads simultaneamente
  • Foco em metas, mentalidade de crescimento e resiliência
  • Equipamentos adequados para trabalho remoto (PC/Laptop + celular)



O que oferecemos

Salário fixo + comissões agressivas (ganhe proporcional à sua performance)

Treinamento personalizado com nosso Head de Vendas

title: Vendedor
description:
Fazer com que nossos clientes se sintam mais confiantes e valorizados para as ocasiões importantes e/ou especiais nas suas vidas.


Sobre a vaga


A nossa visão é estabelecer a Sarto Cavalieri como a principal loja de moda voltada para alfaiataria masculina. Trabalhamos em equipe para aplicar os nossos conhecimentos, habilidades e experiência juntos e criar uma diversidade de ideias e soluções.



O que podes esperar:


  • Prestar um serviço impecável aos nossos clientes e ser um verdadeiro embaixador da marca garantindo que cada cliente seja tratado de acordo com suas expectativas.


  • Adaptar a experiência do cliente para superar suas expectativas, apoiando a equipe, fornecendo, orientando e garantindo o bom andamento da cerimônia de vendas.


  • Demonstrar excelente conhecimento dos produtos, bem como da história da marca Sarto Cavalieri, priorizando o interesse do cliente.


  • Utilizar de forma ativa e proativa as ferramentas da empresa, garantindo o cumprimento dos objetivos individuais e da loja.


  • Construir e manter relacionamentos duradouros com nossos clientes atuais e identificar clientes potenciais para o futuro.


  • Garantir o cumprimento das metas de vendas, para maximizar os resultados da empresa.


  • Apoiar as políticas, objetivos e iniciativas de vendas da empresa.


  • Apoiar todos os canais de vendas existentes na loja.


  • Organizar estoque, salão de vendas entre outros com a finalidade de aprimorar a experiência do cliente.


  • Participar ativamente de treinamentos, reuniões e eventos, buscando desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional contínuo.



O teu perfil:


  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação escrita e verbal
  • Buscando auto- desenvolvimento
  • Pro atividade e dinamismo
  • Engajamento no mundo da Moda
  • Motivação e Organização



O que oferecemos:


  • Desconto em Produtos da marca
  • Remuneração Atrativa / comissão

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
We’re looking for a Product Marketing Manager to own our product-led growth in partnership with our product team — someone who knows how to move the needle and own their outcomes.


About us:


Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. Our SaaS products power tens of millions of conversations monthly, helping real estate professionals close more deals using text and voice.


If you’re used to depending on task queues, waiting for someone to tell you what to do, or only being reactive instead of mostly proactive — this isn’t the role for you.


But if you have a bias for execution and love taking ownership of outcomes — keep reading.


What You’ll Own


  • Drive our PLG initiatives by building campaigns that increase conversions, engagement, retention, upgrades, and cross-sells.
  • Own in-app messaging using tools like AppCues to onboard, convert, and activate users
  • Write high-impact messaging, value propositions, and product comparison landing pages that drive inbound conversion
  • Own and optimize in-app customer self-onboarding — reduce time-to-value, increase sign-to-trial and trial-to-paid conversion rates
  • Collaborate with product, marketing, and sales teams to align go-to-market efforts and drive measurable growth
  • Execute product launches and campaigns leading up to it, and bring a successful playbook you can leverage.
  • Build and manage internal and external product knowledge bases and communications for product updates
  • Be an active contributor in the development and management of customer advocacy programs such as user referral and/or affiliate programs.
  • Track campaign performance and report KPIs with precision — weekly, monthly, quarterly, and yearly
  • Partner with our success team to collect customer feedback through surveys, direct customer communications, and beta groups, and use it to create user stories and case studies.
  • Document campaign playbooks, and external and internal product trainings, using video (Loom), and upload to Trainual

title: Analista de Segurança da Informação II
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro , maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina , e a Fisia , distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades:


-Monitoramento e Resposta (SOC): Atuar como ponto focal em incidentes críticos, realizando análise forense inicial e contenção de ameaças;

- Engenharia de Detecção (SIEM): Criar, tunar e otimizar regras de correlação no SIEM para reduzir falsos positivos e aumentar a visibilidade sobre ataques modernos;

- Inteligência de Ameaças (Threat Intel): Coletar e analisar IOCs (Indicadores de Comprometimento) e TTPs (Táticas, Técnicas e Procedimentos), convertendo inteligência bruta em ações de defesa proativa;

- Gestão de Vulnerabilidades: Liderar o ciclo de vida de vulnerabilidades, desde a varredura e priorização (baseada em risco e exploitability) até o acompanhamento da remediação com os times de infraestrutura e dev;

- Hunting: Realizar buscas proativas por ameaças que possam ter passado despercebidas pelos controles automáticos.


Requisitos Técnicos:

- SIEM: Experiência avançada em plataformas como Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Elastic Security ou QRadar (criação de dashboards e KQL/SPL);

- Frameworks: Domínio do MITRE ATT&CK e NIST Incident Response;

- Threat Intel: Conhecimento em plataformas de TI (MISP, OpenCTI) e consumo de feeds de inteligência;

- Vulnerability Management: Operação de ferramentas como Tenable.

title: Subject Matter Expert – Chartered & Certified Accountants (Remote)
description:
Start Date: Ongoing

Screener Criteria: Active professional certification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, etc.)

Eligible Locations:

Language Requirement: Fluent English

Type of contract: Freelance / On-Call Advisory

Hourly Rate: $60.00

Minimum Hours: No minimum

Maximum Hours: Ad hoc / Subject to project availability


About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


The Opportunity

We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role; instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.

Please note: This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.


What you’ll be doing

When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:

  • Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
  • Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
  • Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional \"human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2B research is accurate and enterprise-ready.


What you’ll bring

  • Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
  • Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
  • Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
  • Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing.


Why join this project?

This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour , you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.


Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant

Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.


We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.


We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.


Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again; simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for opportunities.


Links to more information on Prolific

Website

Youtube


Privacy Statement

By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organization planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific's use of your personal information.

title: Sales AI Agent Builder
description:
Sales AI Agent Builder

Role Overview:

You will architect and manage a fleet of autonomous Sales Agents that perform end-to-end prospecting, qualification, and meeting scheduling. Unlike traditional Sales Ops, you won't just build workflows; you will build reasoning systems that research prospects, handle objections, and manage their own \"inboxes\" to deliver qualified meetings to our SEs. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.

Key Responsibilities:

• Autonomous Lead Qualification: Design agents to \"vet\" inbound leads by querying external data sources and internal CRM history to determine if they meet our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP).

• Inbox Management & Objection Handling: Deploy agents (using LLMs like GPT-4o or Claude) that can read incoming emails, categorize intent, and draft/send context-aware replies to handle common objections.

• Live Sales Assistant (RAG): Build a \"Sales Knowledge Base\" using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) so agents can instantly reference case studies, pricing, and competitor battlecards during autonomous chats.

• CRM Data Integrity: Ensure agents \"write back\" all interactions to Salesforce/HubSpot, keeping data clean and attribution accurate without rep intervention.

Qualifications:

• Experience: 4+ years in Growth or Solutions Engineering in a B2B SaaS environment.

• AI Tooling: Experience with \"Agent-as-a-Service\" platforms (e.g., 11x, Regie.ai, Lyzr) or building custom agents via LangChain / LangGraph.

• Sales Stack Mastery: Deep expertise in Salesforce/HubSpot, Salesloft/Outreach, and data providers like ZoomInfo or 6sense.

• Analytical Rigor: Ability to A/B test agent prompts and \"reasoning loops\" to improve meeting-set rates.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Regulação e Custos de Transmissão III
description:
SOBRE A AXIA ENERGIA

A Eletrobras agora é AXIA Energia e chega como a maior empresa de energia renovável do Hemisfério Sul, responsável por 17% da capacidade de geração nacional e 37% das linhas de transmissão do Sistema Interligado Nacional (SIN).

Mais do que uma mudança de nome, a AXIA representa a evolução de uma companhia sólida, que vem se transformando para atuar com mais agilidade, inovação e foco no cliente em um setor em constante movimento. A nova marca traduz energia, conexão, história e futuro.

Com presença em todas as regiões do país, nosso foco é oferecer soluções completas que catalisem resultados, impulsionando o desenvolvimento do setor e transformando energia em oportunidades para pessoas, negócios e para o planeta.

Na AXIA Energia, o futuro é movido pela potência de quem acredita em transformar. Venha viver o novo com a gente!

ATENÇÃO: A AXIA Energia não cobra taxas para realização de testes, exames ou participação no processo seletivo.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


Estamos em busca de quatro (a) Engenheiros (Sênior) para atuar na Gerência de Estruturação de Dados Técnicos para o BPR e RTP do Sistema de Transmissão de Energia Elétrica da companhia, com foco em assegurar a consistência dos dados técnicos e regulatórios no âmbito da revisão do BPR e da RTP, a qual é fundamental para garantir os retornos dos investimentos realizados pela companhia sob responsabilidade da Vice-Presidência de Engenharia e Expansão (VEE).

Este(a) profissional será responsável por coordenar os levantamentos dos dados técnicos e memórias de cálculos para os projetos de reforços e melhorias que irão subsidiar a revisão do Banco de Preços de Referência e a Revisão Tarifária Periódica, avaliando critérios técnicos, regulatórios e econômico-financeiros, de forma a subsidiar a correta alocação e garantir os objetivos corporativos da Axia Energia.

Responsabilidades

  • Levantar dados técnicos contratuais referentes aos equipamentos por projeto (PEP), garantindo consistência entre os valores efetivamente pagos no CJI3 com as previsões contratuais.
  • Levantar dados contratuais EPCISTA’s identificando as aberturas de canteiro, montagem, engenharia, comissionamento, adm local, custos socioambientais e fundiários, custos indiretos por módulos (UAR, COM e CA) por projeto (PEP), garantindo consistência entre os valores efetivamente pagos no CJI3 com as previsões contratuais direcionadas corretamente para cada item da EAP.
  • Analisar os desvios encontrados entre os valores realizados nos projetos em cada sub-pep, com cruzamento dessas informações com as previsões constantes dos atos regulatórios.
  • Identificar as possíveis necessidades de cadastros no SGPMR/O.N.S, quando não previstas no projeto inicial, e após terem sido confirmadas pela regulação e classificadas como item extrapatrimonial, e encaminhar o levantamento para a área responsável na engenharia por esses cadastros.
  • Atuar de forma efetiva no levantamento dos dados técnicos necessários para garantir o reconhecimento dos investimentos em Transmissão pela nossa empresa, integrando dados técnicos, atos regulatórios e valores realizados no SAP.
  • Enviar as memórias de cálculo para as bases de regulação por empresa (AXIA Energia, AXIA Energia Nordeste, AXIA Energia Norte e AXIA Energia Sul.
  • Fornecer informações para o acompanhamento das alocações (MOP-Cat2 e outros contratos de suporte) nos PEP, garantindo consistência e rastreabilidade pelas rubricas canteiro, montagem, engenharia, comissionamento, adm local, custos socioambientais e fundiários, custos indiretos.



Requisitos e qualificações


  • Formação: Engenharia, preferencialmente elétrica e civil.
  • Experiência: Atuação prévia em empresas do setor elétrico, especialmente em planejamento, implantação de obras de reforços e melhorias de transmissão.
  • Conhecimento dos procedimentos e normativos da ANEEL e do ONS relacionados a reforços e melhorias (Módulo 2 dos Procedimentos de Rede, REN 905/2020 e correlatas).
  • Conhecimento do Módulo 9: Concessionárias de Transmissão Submódulo 9.1 REVISÃO PERIÓDICA DAS RECEITAS DAS CONCESSIONÁRIAS DE TRANSMISSÃO
  • Domínio de ferramentas de gestão e análise de portfólio e projetos (Excel avançado, SAP, Power BI, MS Project).
  • Capacidade analítica, visão sistêmica e orientação a resultados.
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal, com habilidade de interação com diferentes áreas técnicas e níveis hierárquicos.

Diferenciais

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Projetos, Regulação do Setor Elétrico ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento de metodologias de gestão de portfólio e projetos (PMI, Stage-Gate, Lean Project Management).
  • Experiência prévia em empresas transmissoras ou no ONS/ANEEL será considerado diferencial relevante.


Informações adicionais

Benefícios:


Na AXIA Energia, o bem-estar e a qualidade de vida das nossas pessoas impulsionam a energia que nos move. Por isso, criamos um ambiente de trabalho que valoriza o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional, com benefícios que estimulam o desenvolvimento, o cuidado e o crescimento de cada talento que faz parte da nossa jornada. Alguns dos benefícios que disponibilizamos estão disponíveis abaixo:

• Vale-refeição e vale-alimentação;

• Plano Médico e Odontológico;

• Seguro de Vida;

• Previdência Privada;

• Vale-Transporte;

• Wellhub;

• Auxílio-creche;

• Auxílio-educacional;

Se esses benefícios e essa posição fazem sentido para você, inscreva-se já!

title: Kronos Business Analyst
description:
We are still looking for talent… and we would love for you to join our team!


For over 27 years , UST has worked alongside the world’s leading companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Driven by technology, inspired by people, and guided by our purpose, UST supports clients from design to implementation.


Together, with more than 39,000 employees across 30 countries , we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.


About the Role


The Kronos / UKG WFM Business Analyst is responsible for analyzing business requirements and supporting the implementation, configuration, upgrade, and integration of UKG Workforce Management solutions (formerly Kronos) .

The role works closely with business stakeholders, technical teams, and project managers to ensure successful delivery of WFM solutions aligned with business and operational needs.



Responsibilities

  • Gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to Workforce Management (time & attendance, scheduling, labor rules, pay rules, etc.).
  • Translate business requirements into functional and technical design specifications.
  • Configure and support UKG Workforce Management platforms (UKG Pro WFM / Workforce Central).
  • Support end‑to‑end implementation, upgrades, and migrations from WFC to UKG Pro WFM.
  • Design, execute, and support functional testing, integration testing, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) .
  • Work closely with technical, integration, and offshore teams to clarify requirements and resolve issues.
  • Support data extraction, validation, and migration activities.
  • Coordinate with project managers to meet project milestones, timelines, and delivery commitments.
  • Provide training and knowledge transfer to business users and support teams.
  • Support post‑implementation activities and ongoing enhancements as required.
  • Act as a key liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams.


Required Technical Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 7–10+ years of experience working with Kronos / UKG Workforce Management solutions .
  • Strong experience with UKG Workforce Central and/or UKG Pro WFM .
  • Advanced English Level - B2 + - C1
  • Solid experience in requirements gathering and functional solution design.
  • Experience supporting system testing, integrations, and UAT.
  • Understanding of WFM modules such as Timekeeping, Scheduling, Pay Rules, Activities, and Reporting.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong stakeholder and client‑facing skills.
  • Ability to work independently in complex environments.


Nice to have


  • Experience with integrations to HR or payroll systems (e.g., Workday, PeopleSoft).
  • Experience in system upgrades or consolidations.
  • Exposure to Agile or hybrid delivery methodologies.
  • Multilingual skills (Spanish / Portuguese preferred for LATAM roles).


Conditions


  • Contractor - 5 months
  • 100 % remote
  • Colombia - Argentina - Chile or Brazil
  • Agile and highly collaborative technical environment.


We encourage you to apply or reach out for more information.

title: Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
  • Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
  • Ingerir, transformar e disponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
  • Criar e manter tabelas Delta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
  • Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
  • Apoiar a governança de dados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
  • Monitorar execuções de pipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
  • Corrigir causas-raiz e propor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
  • Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;
  • Documentar pipelines, regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
  • Colaborar com analistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
  • Conhecimento prático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
  • Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
  • Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
  • Familiaridade com pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
  • Conhecimento em Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
  • Capacidade de investigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento).
  • Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança).
  • Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados).
  • Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions).
  • Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas).
  • Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos).
  • Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards).
  • Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio).

Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Médico Gastroenterologista
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO GASTROENTEROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Gastroenterologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Gastroenterologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em gastroenterologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais.


  • Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde gastrointestinais.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.



REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA (ou em andamento) OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM GASTROENTEROLOGIA (CLÍNICA OU CIRÚRGICA).


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Gastroenterologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho); ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência médica. Pós ou Especialização na área;
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);


Experiência:

  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em gastroenterologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;
  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico na Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO


Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.



IMPORTANTE:

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
  • Net-worth monitoring;
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
  • Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English .
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Quality Assurence
description:
Estamos buscando profissionais de QA com forte atuação funcional e suporte técnico em automação.


Buscamos profissionais para atuação em qualidade ponta a ponta , com foco em validação funcional, geração de evidências e rastreabilidade das entregas em um ecossistema com microserviços, integrações e múltiplos meios de pagamento .


Essa posição tem foco funcional, porém exige conhecimento obrigatório em JavaScript e Playwright , para apoiar validações técnicas, ajustes de fluxo e interpretações de respostas de APIs quando necessário.


Você fará parte de um time orientado à excelência em qualidade, atuando de forma próxima aos times de desenvolvimento, produto e operações.


Responsabilidades


  • Participar de refinamentos, entendimento de regras de negócio e definição de critérios de aceite.
  • Planejar, executar e evidenciar testes funcionais ponta a ponta.
  • Criar e manter cenários e casos de teste com rastreabilidade no Jira/Xray , utilizando BDD com Gherkin (uso obrigatório) .
  • Executar testes de regressão, testes exploratórios e suporte a UAT/homologação.
  • Validar integrações e fluxos críticos envolvendo APIs, microserviços, mensageria (SQS), ERP e meios de pagamento (Pix, Boleto e Cartão) .
  • Acompanhar incidentes/bugs, apoiar priorização e realizar retestes.
  • Garantir rastreabilidade entre requisito ↔ teste ↔ evidência ↔ defeito .
  • Implementar testes e ajustes utilizando Playwright .
  • Apoiar validações técnicas com JavaScript (ex.: lógica de validação, estruturação de payloads, análise de respostas de APIs, interpretação de objetos JSON e pequenos scripts de apoio).


Requisitos Obrigatórios


  • Experiência com testes funcionais e processos de qualidade em ambientes ágeis.
  • Vivência com sistemas distribuídos e integrações (APIs/microserviços).
  • Experiência com validação de APIs via Postman ou Insomnia .
  • Experiência com Jira e Xray .
  • Uso obrigatório de BDD com Gherkin para criação e manutenção de cenários.
  • Boa escrita de cenários, critérios de aceite e documentação de evidências.
  • Experiência com testes de regressão e priorização de cenários críticos.
  • Conhecimento obrigatório em JavaScript (não atuará como QE, mas precisa interpretar, ajustar e criar pequenos trechos de código).
  • Experiência sólida com Playwright (locators, interações, assertions, waits, screenshots e vídeos).
  • Experiência com CI/CD e execução de testes em pipelines (ex.: Jenkins) .
  • Conhecimento em Docker e ambientes conteinerizados.


Diferenciais


  • Noções de observabilidade (Dynatrace, Loki).
  • Experiência com jornadas de Checkout e Pagamentos (Pix, boleto, cartão) .
  • Noções de segurança/controles (ex.: PCI) aplicados a testes.
  • Conhecimento básico em AWS ou ambientes cloud (multi-account) .


Sobre a OSF Digital


A OSF Digital tem orgulho de ser uma empresa que oferece oportunidades iguais, onde você pode ser você mesmo no trabalho. Junte-se a uma comunidade inclusiva e apaixonada de profissionais que ajudam a promover a transformação digital para empresas ao redor do mundo.

Na OSF Digital, acolhemos todas as pessoas e não discriminamos com base em identidade e expressão de gênero, raça, etnia, deficiência, orientação sexual, cor, religião, origem nacional, idade, estado civil ou qualquer outra categoria protegida em qualquer jurisdição onde atuamos.

title: Ad Operations Specialist
description:
Ad Operations and Trafficking Specialist



AdLib is looking for a DSP Ad Operations and Trafficking Specialist to support our brand and agency partners by ensuring flawless campaign setup, trafficking, QA, and delivery execution across multiple

programmatic platforms. This role is ideal for someone with hands-on experience implementing and

maintaining campaigns across DSPs like BeesWax, Yahoo, Amazon, The Trade Desk, DV360, Moloco, and similar.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Execute end-to-end trafficking and setup across multiple DSPs, including QA and launch

readiness.

• Manage pacing and delivery to ensure budgets and flight dates remain on track.

• Perform detailed QA across targeting, creatives, tracking, and measurement prior to launch.

• Troubleshoot and resolve delivery issues, tracking errors, creative rejections, and platform-level discrepancies.

• Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to ensure campaigns are implemented

correctly and on time.

• Maintain accurate documentation, naming conventions, and operational workflows across platforms.

• Support reporting needs by ensuring campaign data is consistent and properly structured.

• Stay up to date on DSP requirements, ad operations best practices, and evolving programmatic standards.



Whats You Bring

• 2+ years of experience in ad operations, trafficking, or execution across multiple DSPs (BeesWax, Xandr, Amazon, The Trade Desk, DV360, Moloco, etc.).

• Strong understanding of trafficking workflows, pacing, and QA processes in programmatic

advertising.

• Experience troubleshooting delivery, tracking, and technical issues across platforms.

• Familiarity with analytics and measurement tools such as Northbeam, Triple Whale, Appsflyer, and Google Analytics is a plus.

• Detail-oriented mindset with excellent organizational and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to manage multiple active campaigns in a fast-paced, remote work environment.



What We Offer

  • Competitive salary (dependent on region)
  • Fully paid medical, dental, and vision benefits
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Flexible, remote-first culture
  • Coworking space allowance
  • Gym membership reimbursement
  • Mobile phone plan reimbursement

Join us at AdLib and help agencies and brands scale their programmatic media buying smarter, faster, and more profitably

title: Cloud Operations Engineer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


The Cloud Operations Engineer will provide hands-on operational support across Eightpoint's multi-cloud infrastructure spanning AWS and GCP. This role focuses on maintaining reliability, supporting CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring observability across all environments while enabling the DevOps team to focus on project-driven initiatives. The position reports to the Director of IT & Cybersecurity and works closely with the DevOps and Systems Administration teams.


Key Responsibilities


  • Administer and support AWS infrastructure including EKS clusters, Elastic Beanstalk environments, EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS, and IAM across a multi-account environment
  • Support GCP workloads, primarily BigQuery pipelines and related data infrastructure.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot self-hosted applications including Airflow, Grafana, and other internal tooling.
  • Support and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions, including self-hosted runners.
  • Participate in incident response processes — triage, root cause analysis, remediation, and post-incident documentation.
  • Deploy, configure, and maintain logging, monitoring, and alerting tooling (Grafana stack — Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy; CloudWatch; OneUptime).
  • Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.
  • Participate in on-call rotation providing support across US and offshore time zones.
  • Contribute to documentation in Confluence and maintain runbooks for operational procedures.


Who You Are


  • 5+ years of experience in a cloud operations, DevOps, or infrastructure support role.
  • Strong working knowledge of AWS core services (EKS, Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, RDS, CloudFront).
  • Hands-on experience administering containerized workloads (Kubernetes/EKS, Docker).
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions.
  • Demonstrated experience with incident response workflows — detection, escalation, remediation, and RCA.
  • Experience deploying and maintaining observability tooling (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting).
  • Proficiency in Linux administration and shell scripting (Bash, Python).
  • Strong experience with Terraform for infrastructure-as-code.
  • Experience with Atlassian tooling (Jira, JSM, Confluence).


Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience with GCP, specifically BigQuery and related data services.
  • Experience with Grafana OSS stack (Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy/Faro).
  • Experience supporting Airflow or similar orchestration platforms.
  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Associate, SysOps, or DevOps Engineer).
  • Experience working in multi-account AWS environments with consolidated billing/cost allocation tagging.
  • Exposure to ZTNA/VPN solutions (Firezone, Twingate, or similar).

description:

title: Cybersecurity Customer Success Manager - Brazil

  • 2016 : Launched our first product.
  • 2018 : Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019 : Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020 : Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.

  • 2025 : Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.


Role Overview:

As a Customer Success Manager at CloudSEK, you will be the primary point of contact for a few strategic accounts, ensuring they derive maximum value from our cybersecurity solutions. Your role will involve deep engagement with clients, providing expert guidance on threat management, and ensuring seamless integration and utilization of CloudSEK’s products. Your background in cybersecurity will be crucial in understanding and addressing the specific needs and challenges faced by our clients.


Your mission->

I. Account Management:

  • Manage and nurture relationships for a client accounts, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Annual Business Reviews (ABRs) to assess and enhance customer engagement.
  • Visit customers twice a year to strengthen relationships and understand their evolving needs.

II. Cybersecurity Expertise:

  • Provide expert guidance on threat intelligence, data leak prevention, and other cybersecurity issues.
  • Act as a security analyst, offering insights and recommendations based on threats generated by CloudSEK’s platform.
  • Collaborate with customer security teams to ensure optimal usage of CloudSEK’s solutions.

III. Customer Engagement:

  • Develop and execute customer engagement strategies to build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including CXOs and CISOs.
  • Foster customer champions within client organizations to drive advocacy and referrals.
  • Generate and share client-specific quality reports, gathering feedback to continuously improve service delivery.

IV. Revenue Generation and Retention:

  • Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling CloudSEK’s products and services.
  • Ensure on-time renewals and maintain a high customer retention rate.
  • Source referrals and participate in revenue generation activities.

V. Product Usage and Feedback:

  • Ensure 100% product usage for features subscribed by the customers.
  • Conduct configuration reviews and provide recommendations for product enhancements.
  • Gather and analyze customer feedback to contribute to product development and improvement.

VI. Operational Excellence:

  • Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and activities in CRM systems.
  • Contribute to the team by sharing knowledge, conducting training sessions, and writing internal articles.


What we're looking for:

  • 4-5 years of experience in Cybersecurity, Client-facing experience, or a related role in the cybersecurity industry.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, threat intelligence, and digital risk management.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with clients.
  • Proven track record of achieving customer success goals and driving revenue growth.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple accounts simultaneously.


Cookie points if you have experience in the below skills:

  • Business reviews
  • Onsite meetings
  • Maintaining NRR and GRR
  • Threat analysis and Value delivery


Benefits of Joining CloudSEK

We provide an environment where you can develop and enhance your skills while delivering meaningful work that matters. You’ll be rewarded a competitive salary as well as a full spectrum of generous perks and incentives which include:

  • Flexible working hours.
  • Food, unlimited snacks and drinks are all available while at office.

And, the finest part is yet to come! Every now and then we ensure to unwind and have a good time together, which involves games, fun, and soulful music. Feel free to show off your artistic side here!


CloudSEK is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Billing Analyst
description:
About the Role We are hiring a Billing Analyst (Contracts & Invoicing) to support a high-volume, enterprise B2B billing operation within the telecommunications industry. This role owns the contractual and invoicing control stages of the Order-to-Cash process, acting as a quality, compliance, and accuracy gate between approved Purchase Orders and customer invoices. The position requires strong ERP execution, billing governance, and cross-functional organization.


Key Responsibilities

  • Execute and control the Contracts & Invoicing stages of the Order-to-Cash process.
  • Validate sales orders and invoices against Purchase Orders (POs), contracts, pricing references, and billing structures.
  • Create, update, and validate Sales Orders in ERP systems.
  • Prepare and review invoice drafts, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and audit readiness.
  • Manage invoice issuance, correction, and cancellation workflows with full traceability.
  • Register invoices and supporting documentation in official repositories.
  • Submit or share invoices through customer portals and approved channels.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Contracts, Projects, PMO, Warehouse, and Finance to obtain required billing inputs.
  • Track invoice status, blockers, aging, and SLAs, ensuring disciplined follow-up.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Law, or related fields. Experience in Billing, Invoicing, Contract Administration, or Revenue Operations.
  • Strong knowledge of Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes.
  • Hands-on experience with ERP systems (TOTVS Protheus highly desirable).
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (controls, reconciliations, reporting).
  • Working knowledge of indirect taxation and invoice compliance.
  • Professional proficiency in English.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in telecommunications, infrastructure, or technology services.
  • Exposure to enterprise or Tier-1 customers.
  • Familiarity with invoice submission portals, acceptance workflows, and billing SLAs.
  • Experience operating in high-volume, month-end driven environments.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer - (Vue / Node.js)
description:
This is a 100% Remote Independent Contractor Role.


About Equate Media

Equate Media is a growth-focused digital company that builds software and operational systems designed to improve efficiency, support customer engagement, and drive measurable business results. Our teams work closely across engineering, marketing, and operations to solve practical problems, improve workflows, and create systems that make a real impact. We value speed, ownership, adaptability, and people who enjoy building useful things in a fast-moving environment.


About the role

We’re hiring a Senior Full Stack Developer to help strengthen and expand a real-time communications platform used every day by the business. This person will step into an existing production environment, work through active issues, improve platform reliability, and help push new functionality into production quickly.


The work touches both frontend and backend systems tied to inbound and outbound call activity, routing logic, internal buffering, operational tooling, and live user workflows. This is a strong fit for someone who enjoys solving real production problems, working across the stack, and making meaningful contributions without a lot of hand-holding.


Where you’ll make an impact

  • Get up to speed quickly in an existing multi-service production platform
  • Investigate and resolve issues across frontend, backend, and third-party integrations
  • Deliver new features at a high pace while keeping stability and maintainability in mind
  • Improve systems that support real-time call flows, routing behavior, and internal buffering
  • Build and refine interfaces used for live operations and communication workflows
  • Develop backend services, APIs, and platform functionality tied directly to business performance
  • Help improve visibility, reliability, and overall behavior in a live production environment
  • Contribute to engineering decisions and help raise execution standards across the team


Tools and environment

  • Frontend: Vue 3, TypeScript, Vite, Pinia, Vue Router
  • Backend: Node.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, Express
  • Real-time / Communications: Socket.IO, WebRTC, browser based calling with Twilio/Sinch/similar system
  • Infrastructure / Services: AWS, Redis, RabbitMQ / AMQP, PM2
  • Monitoring / Error Tracking: Sentry


What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of experience as a full stack software developer
  • Strong backend experience with Node.js
  • Strong frontend experience with Vue, or strong experience with a modern frontend framework and the ability to work confidently in a Vue codebase
  • Experience working in existing production systems, not only creating from scratch
  • Ability to troubleshoot across the stack and solve real-world issues efficiently
  • Experience shipping features quickly in fast-moving environments
  • Strong instincts around performance, reliability, and maintainability
  • Comfortable taking ownership and operating independently
  • Experience with AWS or other cloud-based production environments
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams


Bonus Points For

  • Telephony, VoIP, call routing, or communications platforms
  • Twilio, Sinch, or similar providers
  • Real-time systems, event-driven architecture, queues, or worker-based services
  • Redis, RabbitMQ, or live operational workflows
  • Improving legacy systems while continuing to ship new functionality
  • Exposure to AI-assisted workflows such as transcription, summarization, or automation


Why this role stands out

This is an opportunity to work on a live platform that supports real operational activity and directly impacts the business. You’ll be solving practical problems, improving systems that people rely on every day, and helping shape what gets built next. If you enjoy working in production systems, fixing meaningful problems, and shipping useful features quickly, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Role Overview


Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.


Key Responsibilities


Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.
  • Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

  • Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript).
  • Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks.
  • Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

  • Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365).
  • Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access.
  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.


Required Qualifications & Skills


Technical Experience:

  • 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures.
  • High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting.
  • Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows.

title: SAP S/4HANA Finance Consultant

Genesis Consulting has an immediate opportunity for an experienced SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI) Consultant to support a global operation S/4HANA. The SAP S/4HANA FI Consultant will act as a functional utility player across the Finance workstream, supporting General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Funds Management, and integration with Procurement, Asset Management, and Payroll. The role requires hands-on participation across all phases of the implementation lifecycle, including design, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-go-live support.



The consultant will work closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to ensure financial processes are aligned to SAP S/4HANA best practices while supporting the client’s operational and regulatory requirements. This includes supporting the transition from ECC-based processes to S/4HANA capabilities, including Fiori-enabled user experiences and embedded analytics.



The FI Consultant will also assist in identifying opportunities to streamline legacy processes, reduce customizations, and leverage standard S/4HANA functionality, while ensuring continuity of critical financial operations during the system conversion.



Duties and Responsibilities:


The Consultant facilitates the implementation and support of SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions to enhance the client’s financial operations and overall system performance, while maintaining a high degree of customer satisfaction.

  • Support the migration and validation of financial data, including balances, open items, and asset data during conversion activities
  • Assist in identifying and supporting remediation of custom code, reports, interfaces, and enhancements impacting Finance processes
  • Support Fiori application enablement, including validation of finance-related apps, roles, and user experience considerations
  • Participate in System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and defect resolution across financial and cross-functional scenarios
  • Collaborate with technical and data teams to support integration, reporting, and data reconciliation activities
  • Support cutover planning and execution, including financial readiness activities and validation of key processes
  • Provide post-go-live support and stabilization assistance for financial operations



Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

  • 3-5 years of SAP experience with a strong focus on Finance (FI) in ECC and S/4HANA environments
  • At least two full lifecycle SAP implementations, including at least one S/4HANA conversion or implementation
  • Hands-on experience with core FI modules including GL, AP, AR, and Asset Accounting
  • Functional integration experience with SAP modules including MM, EAM, HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Experience supporting financial data migration, reconciliation, and validation activities
  • Experience with SAP Fiori applications and understanding of role-based access and user experience
  • Experience supporting testing cycles including SIT and UAT in integrated SAP environments
  • Working knowledge of custom code impacts (reports, interfaces, enhancements) and ability to support functional validation
  • Experience with SAP reporting and analytics, including embedded analytics or BW-based reporting
  • Strong understanding of financial close processes, including month-end and year-end activities
  • Experience working in Agile or SAP Activate-based delivery models


Minimum Education:


  • Bachelor’s Degree – Preferred
  • Bachelor of Science or Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical/Computer Engineering or equivalent experience preferred or Accounting (preferred).



Required Certifications:


  • Certification in S/4 HANA, and/or other SAP Solutions is a plus.



Other:


  • Experience working in distributed delivery environments, including coordination with offshore or nearshore teams (e.g., LATAM delivery centers)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work directly with business stakeholders
  • Ability to support a hybrid delivery model with remote and on-site collaboration as required

title: Go High Level (GHL) Intern

Acadium started with the belief that anyone, anywhere, should be able to get the skills and experience they need to start their career without barriers like price, schedule, or location getting in their way. title: Customer Success Specialist, Life Sciences
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as University of Sao Paulo, Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.

As a Customer Success Specialist, you will help professors at leading universities in the US integrate JoVE videos into their courses to improve teaching outcomes and student success. You'll play a key role in ensuring users get the most value from their JoVE subscription.



Please share your resume in English.

  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Engenheiro de Dados Sênior
description:
Sobre a Volpi

Somos uma fintech em crescimento acelerado que está protagonizando a evolução do financiamento imobiliário . Transformamos processos tradicionalmente burocráticos, caros e ineficientes em experiências inteligentes, simples e digitais . Se você acredita que tecnologia pode mudar a vida das pessoas - e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que vive isso na prática - vem com a gente!


O desafio

Buscamos um Senior Data Engineer para liderar a construção da engenharia de dados da Volpi desde a base.

Hoje, nossos dados estão distribuídos em múltiplas fontes, com diferentes níveis de maturidade. Seu papel será estruturar essa fundação: definir a arquitetura, organizar os dados, criar pipelines confiáveis e habilitar a criação de produtos de dados que apoiem decisões críticas de negócio.

Aqui, você terá alto nível de autonomia e ownership , tomando decisões técnicas que vão sustentar o crescimento da empresa nos próximos anos.


O que você vai fazer:

  • Desenhar, implementar e evoluir a arquitetura de dados da Volpi , com foco em um modelo de lakehouse na AWS;
  • Estruturar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e consumo de dados (batch e, futuramente, streaming);
  • Trabalhar com dados sensíveis de crédito e pessoas, seguindo padrões rigorosos de segurança, governança e compliance ;
  • Lidar com dados distribuídos em múltiplos silos , conectando fontes e criando visões mais maduras para o negócio;
  • Atender demandas estratégicas de diferentes áreas (crédito, operações, produto, engenharia);
  • Organizar e evoluir o data lake existente (já temos estrutura inicial em AWS, Athena e S3);
  • Criar a base para produtos de dados futuros , incluindo análises avançadas de crédito e soluções orientadas a dados;
  • Atuar de forma full-cycle, da concepção técnica à implementação, operação e evolução em produção.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência sólida como Data Engineer , com forte mentalidade de engenharia (Data Engineer aqui é dev);
  • Domínio de Python e SQL para construção de pipelines e soluções de dados em produção;
  • Experiência prática com AWS , especialmente serviços como S3, Athena e IAM;
  • Conhecimento e uso de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) ;
  • Vivência com pipelines de dados em produção, lidando com volumes relevantes e dados sensíveis;
  • Forte preocupação com segurança da informação , padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia;
  • Experiência em ambientes de startup , lidando com pouco legado e muita construção do zero;
  • Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas e conduzir projetos end-to-end;
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados escaláveis;
  • Comunicação clara e estruturada, especialmente em ambientes assíncronos.


Será considerado um diferencial:

  • Experiência com arquiteturas de dados modernas, como lakehouse;
  • Uso de ferramentas de orquestração e transformação de dados (ex: Airflow, dbt ou similares);
  • Atuação em domínios complexos e regulados, como financeiro, crédito ou seguros;
  • Vivência na construção e estruturação de plataformas ou áreas de dados desde o início.



Benefícios que oferecemos:

  • Plano de saúde Alice (100% pago para titular e dependentes)
  • R$600/ano para infraestrutura de home office
  • R$1.000/ano de auxílio educação

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!
Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.Minimum Requirements:Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

title: Emerging market trader
description:
Role OverviewWe are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.
Key Responsibilities
FX Trading & Liquidity Management
Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.
Hedging Strategy & Risk Management
Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization.
Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books.
Trading Infrastructure & Systems
Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including:
Automated hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation systems
Smart order routing
Pricing and risk management tools
Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.
Market Development
Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.
Requirements
Experience
5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as:
Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
Experience working at:
Global banks
EM FX trading firms
Payment / fintech companies
Crypto exchanges or market makers
Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades.
Technical Expertise
Deep understanding of:
FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
NDF markets and offshore hedging
Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
FX trading systems
Hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation platforms
Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution.
Skills
Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments.
Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks.
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations.
Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources.
Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies.
Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations.
Strong analytical and problem solving skills
Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments
Vision & Mission
OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

description:
